source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether many adolescent changes, including menstruation and other signs of puberty, are mainly caused and regulated by hormones produced in the body.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Menstruation produces the hormones that start puberty.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Every change during adolescence, including choosing new friends, is mainly caused by hormones.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Menstruation is caused mainly by a wound inside the body.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: Healthy choices and emotional support, rather than hormones, regulate the start of menstruation.

intelligence.enrichment: Many changes in adolescence, including menstruation and other signs of puberty, are mainly due to hormones, which are chemicals produced in the body. Hormones regulate various aspects of growth during adolescence. hormones produced in the body -> regulation of growth and puberty changes -> adolescent physical and reproductive changes The learner explains many adolescent changes, including menstruation and other signs of puberty, as mainly due to hormones produced in the body that regulate growth and development. Hormones are just feelings or outside influences that appear after puberty changes happen.
